description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each request.

description.zh:
终端节点组描述信息。

描述长度最大256字符，不能包含`http://`和`https://`字符。
description.en:
The description of the endpoint group.

The description can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://` characters.
The ID of the endpoint group.

description.zh:
终端节点组的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The name of the endpoint group.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.zh: 修改自定义路由类型监听关联的终端节点组名称和描述信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga update-custom-routing-endpoint-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --name group1 --description EndpointGroup --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga UpdateCustomRoutingEndpointGroupAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --EndpointGroupId 'epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000' --Description EndpointGroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name group1
